sentences.text:
Shri Samar Ghuraiya - Public Prosecutor for respondent No.3/
 Order

The present petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure has been preferred by the petitioner/complainant challenging the order dated 27.11.2012 passed by this Court in a previous petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C. bearing M.Cr.C.No.8149/2012 filed by the accused persons/respondents No.1 and 2 herein, wherein the order of framing of charge dated 09.07.2012 passed in criminal case No.1298/10 by JMFC, Guna for offence punishable under Section 420 of IPC as well as the order of its confirmation dated 31.08.2012 passed in criminal revision No.147/12 by 3rd ASJ, Guna was quashed.
2.

Learned counsel for the State, at the outset, submitted that the present petition is wholly misconceived and not maintainable, inasmuch as the order passed by this Court in exercise of its inherent jurisdiction under Section 482 Cr.P.C. cannot be subjected to challenge by way of another petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C.
The proper course for the petitioner, if NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:20854 2 MCRC-15-2013 aggrieved, is to seek remedy in accordance with law before the higher forum.
3. Having heard learned counsel for the State and on perusal of the record, this Court finds substance in the objection raised by learned counsel for the State.
Once an order has been passed by this Court under Section 482 Cr.P.C., the same attains finality unless challenged before the Hon'ble Supreme Court by way of special leave petition.

A second petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C. seeking to assail an order already passed in a previous petition filed under section 482 of Cr.P.C. is not Smt.Geeta Mishra vs Ravi Pachori on 8 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/187732934/

1 maintainable.
4. In view of the settled position of law, this Court is of the opinion that the present petition is not maintainable and is liable to be dismissed.
5. Accordingly, the petition stands dismissed as not maintainable.

(MILIND RAMESH PHADKE) JUDGE ojha Smt.Geeta Mishra vs Ravi Pachori on 8 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/187732934/
